[
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Las + Vegas; Vegas = vega (Spanish) = fertile plain; las = the (fem. pl.)",
    "reading": "The fertile plains — a green meadow hidden in the desert sound.",
    "languages": ["es", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Vega from Iberian/Romance *vaga, from Latin vāga (wandering, roaming); las = illas (those)",
    "reading": "Those wandering fields — lands that shift and drift, not fixed.",
    "languages": ["la", "es"],
    "source": "Oxford Latin Dictionary, s.v. vāgus",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Las = l'as (French: the ace); Vegas = vagues (French: waves, or vagueness)",
    "reading": "The ace of waves — a lucky roll on a sea of uncertainty.",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Las Vegas → 'salvages' (to save from wreck) + 'gas' (spirit, vapour)",
    "reading": "Salvaged spirit — what is rescued from the vaporous illusion.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "L.V. = Lumen Veritatis (light of truth) in Latin; also LV = 55 in Roman numerals",
    "reading": "Light of truth, but numbered 55 — double five, the pentagram's gate.",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "L (el) = God in Hebrew; V = vav (hook/nail); S = shin (tooth/fire); G = gimel (camel)",
    "reading": "God's nail, fire's tooth, camel's hump — a beast of burden in the burning.",
    "languages": ["he", "en"],
    "source": "Sefer Yetzirah (letter correspondences)",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Las = 30+1+60 = 91 (Hebrew values); Vegas = 6+5+3+1+60 = 75; total 166",
    "reading": "166 — the number of the 'gate of the abyss' in some cabalistic lists.",
    "languages": ["he", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Las = l'as (the ace); Vegas = vega (meadow) + s (plural) — 'aces of meadows'",
    "reading": "Aces of meadows — winning hands dealt on green felt, a pun on grass.",
    "languages": ["fr", "es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Vega from Arabic بَقْعَة (baqʿa) = patch of ground, via Mozarabic; las = from Latin illas",
    "reading": "Those patches of ground — a quilt of cultivated earth in arid land.",
    "languages": ["ar", "la", "es"],
    "source": "Real Academia Española, Diccionario de la lengua española, s.v. vega",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Las = laisse (French: leave, let); Vegas = vagues (vague, indistinct) — 'leave the vague'",
    "reading": "Leave the vague — a call to clarity, or to abandon the indistinct.",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Las Vegas → 'savages' + 'el' (God) — 'savages of God'",
    "reading": "God's wild ones — untamed nature under a divine name.",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "L = lamed (ox goad); V = vav (nail); S = shin (fire); G = gimel (camel) — 'goad, nail, fire, camel'",
    "reading": "A goad drives the camel through fire — the path of the initiate.",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "Sepher ha-Zohar (letter meditations)",
    "confidence": 0.4
  }
]
